subject: general
question: What is the name of Google’s largest campus in India, unveiled in February 2025, that marks a milestone in the ongoing seismic shift in technology?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ananta**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Google’s largest campus in India**, unveiled in **February 2025**, is named **Ananta**. The name signifies **infinity** and reflects the company’s commitment to innovation and technological advancements.
 
• The campus is located in **Hyderabad, Telangana**, which is a major hub for IT and technology-driven industries in India.
 
• This campus spans a massive area of **7.3 acres**, making it one of Google’s largest campuses globally, showcasing the tech giant’s emphasis on India as a key growth market.
 
• The facility is designed to incorporate **sustainability** and **environment-friendly practices**, including the use of renewable energy and advanced water conservation systems.
 
• It will serve as a hub for Google’s operations in India, focusing on **AI, cloud computing, and digital transformation**, contributing significantly to the country’s digital economy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Significance of Hyderabad:**

 
 
• Hyderabad is known as **India’s Silicon Valley**, hosting numerous IT and software companies.
 
• It is the headquarters for many global tech companies, including **Microsoft, Amazon, and Facebook**, making it a strategic location for Google’s expansion.
 
 
 
• **Google’s investment in India:**
 
 
• Google has committed to investing **$10 billion** in India over the next decade as part of its **Google for India Digitization Fund**.
 
• The focus areas include **internet accessibility, digital literacy, and AI-driven solutions** tailored for India’s unique needs.
 
 
 
• **Sustainability Features:**
 
 
• The campus is designed with **LEED-certified green building standards** and integrates **renewable energy sources** like solar power.
 
• It includes **rainwater harvesting systems** and advanced energy-efficient technologies to minimize environmental impact.
 
 
 
• **Role in Digital Economy:**
 
 
• The campus will serve as a **research and development center**, focusing on **AI, cloud computing, and machine learning**.
 
• It aims to support India’s growing startup ecosystem and promote **digital transformation** across industries.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Other Names Considered:**

 
 
• **Mahakaya:** While this name represents grandeur, it was not chosen for the campus.
 
• **Kshitij:** This name symbolizes the horizon, reflecting potential and growth, but it wasn’t selected.
 
• **Vishaal:** This name signifies vastness, aligning with the scale of the campus, yet it didn’t make the final cut.
 
 
 
• **Global Presence:**
 
 
• Google has similar large campuses in locations like **Mountain View, California** (Googleplex), and **London, UK**.
 
• The Hyderabad campus reaffirms India’s importance in Google’s global strategy.
